## Setup

```{python}
import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objs as go
import torch

from inf_bp_texts.analysis import FitModelConfig, fit_single_model
from inf_bp_texts.simulation import simulate_bdp_ages_from_distributions
from inf_bp_texts.visualization.plotting import (
    apply_professional_styling,
    apply_tufte_axes,
    gridcolor,
    paper_bgcolor,
    plot_bgcolor,
    ptolqual,
)
```

## Simulate One Dataset

```{python}
birth_rate = 0.005
death_rate = birth_rate - 0.004
time_span = 1500.0
seed = 42

rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
sampled = simulate_bdp_ages_from_distributions(
    birth_rate=torch.tensor(birth_rate, dtype=torch.float64),
    death_rate=torch.tensor(death_rate, dtype=torch.float64),
    max_time=torch.tensor(time_span, dtype=torch.float64),
    rng=rng,
)
ages = np.asarray(sampled["spine"] + sampled["non_spine"], dtype=np.float64)

print(f"Population size: {len(ages)}")
print(f"First 10 ages: {ages[:10].tolist()}")
```

## Fit One Simulation

```{python}
fit_config = FitModelConfig(
    times=time_span,
    is_ordered=True,
    perturb_initial_params_std=0.0,
    initial_birth_rates=np.array([birth_rate], dtype=float),
    initial_death_rates=np.array([death_rate], dtype=float),
)
single_fit_result = fit_single_model(ages, fit_config)
print(single_fit_result)
```

## Profile One Fit

```{python}
%%prun -s cumulative -q -l 30 -T prof-single-fit.txt -D prof-single-fit.prof

_ = fit_single_model(ages, fit_config)
```

## NLL Convergence

```{python}
optimization_result = (
    single_fit_result.get("optimization_result")
    if isinstance(single_fit_result, dict)
    else None
)
attempts = (
    optimization_result.get("attempts", [])
    if isinstance(optimization_result, dict)
    else []
)
selected_attempt_index = (
    optimization_result.get("selected_attempt_index")
    if isinstance(optimization_result, dict)
    else None
)
selected_attempt = None
if isinstance(attempts, list) and attempts:
    if isinstance(selected_attempt_index, int) and 0 <= selected_attempt_index < len(
        attempts
    ):
        selected_attempt = attempts[selected_attempt_index]
    else:
        selected_attempt = attempts[0]
nll_history = (
    selected_attempt.get("nll_history", [])
    if isinstance(selected_attempt, dict)
    else []
)

if nll_history:
    fig_nll = go.Figure()
    fig_nll.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=list(range(1, len(nll_history) + 1)),
            y=nll_history,
            mode="lines",
            line=dict(color=ptolqual[1], width=2),
            name="NLL",
        )
    )
    fig_nll.update_layout(
        title="Negative Log-Likelihood vs Optimization Step",
        xaxis_title="Step",
        yaxis_title="Negative Log-Likelihood",
        showlegend=False,
        plot_bgcolor=plot_bgcolor,
        paper_bgcolor=paper_bgcolor,
    )
    fig_nll = apply_professional_styling(
        fig_nll, None, "Step", "Negative Log-Likelihood"
    )
    fig_nll = apply_tufte_axes(fig_nll)
    fig_nll.update_xaxes(showgrid=True, gridcolor=gridcolor)
    fig_nll.update_yaxes(showgrid=True, gridcolor=gridcolor)
    fig_nll.show()
else:
    print("No NLL history available for this fit.")
```

```{python}
# | label: compile-time-report

# | echo: false

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import time

doc_name = "methods_validation_single_fit_debug.qmd"
project_dir = Path(os.environ.get("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", Path.cwd()))
compile_log = project_dir / "_output" / "compile_times.json"
compile_log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

duration_seconds = time.perf_counter() - __compile_start
timestamp = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

try:
    data = json.loads(compile_log.read_text()) if compile_log.exists() else {}
except Exception:
    data = {}

data[doc_name] = {"duration_seconds": duration_seconds, "timestamp": timestamp}
compile_log.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

print(f"Render duration (non-cached): {duration_seconds:.2f}s")
```
